title: Martini3-IDP: improved Martini 3 force field for disordered proteins.
authors: Wang, Liguo; Brasnett, Christopher; Borges-Araujo, Luis; Souza, Paulo C T; Marrink, Siewert J
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了改进的Martini3-IDP粗粒化力场，通过优化键合参数使无序蛋白构象更膨胀，并验证了其在IDP-膜/小分子结合及液-液相分离凝聚体形成中的适用性，属于无序蛋白互作机制建模的物理模拟方法贡献。
abstract: Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics (MD) is widely used for the efficient simulation of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). The Martini model, one of the most popular CG force fields in biomolecular simulation, was reported to yield too compact IDP conformations, limiting its applications. Addressing this, we optimized the bonded parameters based on fitting to reference simulations of a diverse set of IDPs at atomistic resolution, resulting in a Martini3-based disordered protein model coined Martini3-IDP. This model leads to expanded IDP conformations, greatly improving the reproduction of the experimentally measured radii of gyration. Moreover, contrary to ad-hoc fixes based on scaling of protein-protein or protein-water interactions, Martini3-IDP keeps the overall interaction balance underlying Martini 3. To validate that, we perform a comprehensive testing including full-length multidomain proteins, IDP-lipid membrane binding and IDP-small molecule binding, confirming its ability to successfully capture the complex interplay between disordered proteins and diverse biomolecular components. Finally, the recently emerging concept of biomolecular condensate, through liquid-liquid phase separation, was also reproduced by Martini3-IDP for a number of both homotypic and heterotypic systems. With the improved Martini3-IDP model, we expand the ability to simulate processes involving IDPs in complex environments, at spatio-temporal scales inaccessible with all-atom models.
abstract_zh: 粗粒化（CG）分子动力学（MD）被广泛用于 intrinsically disordered proteins（IDPs）的高效模拟。Martini 模型是生物分子模拟中最流行的 CG 力场之一，据报道其产生的 IDP 构象过于紧凑，限制了其应用。针对这一问题，我们基于对多种 IDP 在原子分辨率下的参考模拟进行拟合，优化了键合参数，从而开发出一种基于 Martini3 的无序蛋白模型，命名为 Martini3-IDP。该模型导致 IDP 构象扩展，显著提高了对实验测量的回转半径的再现能力。此外，与基于缩放蛋白-蛋白或蛋白-水相互作用的临时修正不同，Martini3-IDP 保持了 Martini 3 的整体相互作用平衡。为验证这一点，我们进行了全面测试，包括全长多结构域蛋白、IDP-脂质膜结合及 IDP-小分子结合，确认其能够成功捕捉无序蛋白与多种生物分子组分之间的复杂相互作用。最后，通过液-液相分离形成的生物分子凝聚体这一新兴概念，也在多种同型和异型系统中被 Martini3-IDP 成功再现。借助改进的 Martini3-IDP 模型，我们扩展了在复杂环境中模拟涉及 IDP 过程的能力，覆盖了全原子模型无法触及的时空尺度。
